# What is the cheapest ration that still meets your cattle's needs?

> Free beef cattle ration optimizer. Enter your feeds with price per ton and nutrient content, choose cow, bull, stocker or finishing class, and get the least-cost ration per head per day, herd cost and a buying list. A least-cost feed formulation solver in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
